title: Plynth add-on cache, version 2
description: addons.json in the settings folder: which add-ons were saved as enabled and found on disk when a Blender was last asked (core/include/plynth/core/Addons.h). A cache only; deleting it means the add-ons are not checked yet, and so does a file of an older version.

blender.description: The Blender executable that was asked, absolute, forward slashes.

enabled.description: Enabled add-ons and extensions, sorted by module.
